why: A July 2025 arXiv preprint (Christoph et al., 'New bounds for linear arboricity and related problems') claims an improved bound la(G) ≤ Δ/2 + O(log n), directly improving the conjecture's own quantity beyond the prior Lang-Postle bound; a December 2025 preprint claims a proof of the conjecture for graphs of sufficiently large girth, settling a case of it.
